newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan to issue T$150 bln gov't bonds in FY '97/98. [CORRECTED 10:50 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Taiwan to issue T$150 bln gov't bonds in FY '97/98. [CORRECTED 10:50 GMT]

text.p: (Corrects fiscal year from 1998/99 in headline and throughout)
Taiwan's finance ministry said on Tuesday it planned to issue T$150 billion in government bonds in fiscal 1997/98 (July/June) to meet government budget demands.
"The total bond issues for the entire year is set at T$150 billion," the ministry said in an announcement.
The ministry said it planned to launch five issues of T$30 billion each in September, November, December, February and March.
The ministry said the T$30 billion amount for each issue was the "most appropriate scale" for Taiwan's debt market.
In fiscal 1996-97 just ended, Taiwan launched seven government bond issues worth a total of T$245 billion. In the preceding fiscal year, it issued T$130 billion worth of bonds.
